findings.governingReading: 負けず嫌い characterizes a desire not to lose; Saber links it positively to unyielding spirit in battle.
findings.explanation: Not liking defeat becomes being a sore loser in Saber’s praise of Shirou.

findings.highlight: Ugh... Geez, fine! I'll go anywhere you want!
findings.evidenceJa: こうなったら何処へだって付き合ってやるっ！
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s agreement to follow, glasses refusal, and batting complaint are explicitly bracketed speech.
findings.explanation: Three spoken passages lose quotation marks.

findings.highlight: Saber subtly offers me the menu.
findings.evidenceJa: メニューを薦めてくるセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber casually recommends a menu item, her mango-rush suggestion just spoken.
findings.explanation: A menu recommendation becomes offering the menu document.

findings.highlight: the gestures that I've gotten used to seeing makes my heart skip a beat.
findings.evidenceJa: 見慣れた仕草でさえ心臓が跳ね上がる
findings.governingReading: Even familiar gestures make his heart jump.

findings.highlight: something like a cage falls on me
findings.evidenceJa: 何か澱のようなモノが落ちてきて
findings.governingReading: Something like sediment or dregs descends as he recognizes his enjoyment and tells himself he does not deserve it.
findings.explanation: A sediment-like feeling becomes a falling cage. His enjoyment and self-denial remain, but the image expressing their collision changes.

findings.highlight: held onto the bat in the back after that.
findings.evidenceJa: 奥でハンドル握ってた
findings.governingReading: After two games she was at the back holding a ハンドル, a handle/control. No exact machine is named.
findings.explanation: Rin’s subsequent handle becomes a bat.

findings.highlight: It's not like it has to be there
findings.evidenceJa: 目当ての店ってわけじゃない
findings.governingReading: Rin denies a target shop but insists she has planned the destination, then names the park.
findings.explanation: Not having a particular shop becomes a shop being optional.

findings.governingReading: 油汚れ names the oil/grease character of the sauce mark as he attempts to remove it.
findings.explanation: The explicitly oily stain becomes only a stubborn stain.

findings.highlight: She's looking forward to seeing me worn out from being dragged around than the actual activities itself.
findings.evidenceJa: 午後の遊びが楽しみっていうより
findings.governingReading: He reads Rin’s smile as anticipating his exhaustion more than the activities themselves.
findings.explanation: The preference comparison loses more and plural activities takes itself.

findings.evidenceJa: 何もなかったけど、ありがとう
findings.governingReading: He acknowledges nothing happened, then thanks her in the exchange about why she stayed and his bodily risk.
